page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-4x.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8469C processors operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates four hardware GPUs with a combined video memory capacity of 384 GB. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 50 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents a high-density accelerator configuration, where cost efficiency is driven by the consolidation of multiple GPUs and a high vCPU count on a single dedicated host. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, which requires relying on network storage for data persistence. This configuration is designed for workloads such as large-scale machine learning model training, deep learning inference, data science pipelines, and complex parallel computing tasks.
